title: Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) - Colorado Springs, CO
description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

• Inclusive, socially responsible, clie

title: Staff Software Engineer - Postgres Control Plane
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is now building a world class OLTP service on Postgres. We’re hiring Senior Postgres Engineers to help build the new Snowflake Postgres service. This is an exciting opportunity to help build a large scale, multi-cloud Postgres offering with access to an existing customer base.

AS A SENIOR POSTGRES ENGINEER YOU WILL:

- Develop orchestration layer/ control-plane of large scale databases

- Work with AWS, Azure, and GCP APIs

- Build High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions

- Tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest datasets in the world

- Secure and ensure customer data is protected

- Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry and help redefine the space by inventing at various layers of the software stack - from broad distributed systems to low-level optimizations that fundamentally change the performance characteristics of the system to cater to our customer needs.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR POSTGRES ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- 7+ years industry experience designing, building and developing large scale systems in production

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, highly available, fault tolerant services

- Excellent understanding of low level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, performance, and scale

- Extremely strong fundamental computer science skills

- Experience with Java, Python/Ruby & Go

- Experience running & maintaining large Postgres servers

- Familiarity with cloud networking (VPCs, PrivateLink, Peering, etc)

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

THE FOLLOWING ARE CONSIDERED A PLUS:

- Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science

- Deep, expert knowledge of Postgres (WAL, extensions, configuration, replication, etc)

- Experience designing and implementing large systems for public or private clouds

- FedRAMP and DoD deployment experience

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Senior Development Fabrication Technician
tags: Hardware Platform : Hardware Engineering Services : Dev Fabrication
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Development Fabrication team within Mechanical Services turns early engineering concepts into physical hardware for some of Anduril’s highest-priority programs.

This is not a production line.

Our team builds low-volume, high-complexity prototype hardware - custom chassis, structural frames, fixtures, test articles, and complex weldments - often while designs are still evolving. Fabricators work directly with design engineers to determine how hardware should actually be built, identify problems before they reach integration, and rapidly turn ideas into functional hardware.

Every build is different. The drawings may change. The material may fight you. A design that works perfectly in CAD may not work on the shop floor. Our job is to figure it out - quickly, safely, and correctly.

The result is a highly collaborative prototype environment where experienced fabricators are trusted for their judgment, not simply handed a print and told to weld.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Development Fabrication Technician, you will take prototype hardware from drawing to finished assembly .

You’ll plan the build, select the right fabrication approach, lay out and fit components, weld and machine hardware, design fixtures, inspect your work, and solve problems as they emerge.

You will work directly with engineers when drawings are incomplete, tolerances create problems, or a design simply isn’t practical to manufacture. You’ll be expected to speak up, recommend a better path, and help the team get to the right hardware faster.

Some days you may fabricate a small precision assembly. Others may involve a large structural weldment or prototype supporting an entirely new vehicle or system.

This role is built for an experienced fabricator who wants complex problems, autonomy, variety, and ownership - not repetitive production work.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

•
Own prototype builds from start to finish , translating engineering drawings, CAD, and work orders into finished hardware ready for integration or testing.

•
Determine the best build sequence, fabrication approach, tooling, fixturing, and material preparation strategy for each job.

•
Fabricate small through large-scale assemblies using layout, fitting, welding, cutting, drilling, grinding, forming, sawing, and conventional machining.

•
Build complex weldments across steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and other alloys using GMAW, FCAW, and GTAW processes.

•
Design and build weld fixtures and tooling that maintain alignment and tight tolerances during fabrication.

•
Identify fit-up, tolerance, accessibility, distortion, sequencing, and manufacturability problems before they become integration problems .

•
Work directly with design engineers to resolve unclear drawings, incomplete designs, and manufacturability challenges.

•
Challenge designs when necessary and recommend practical changes that improve buildability, quality, and speed .

•
Perform dimensional and visual inspection of completed hardware and make sound decisions around rework, repair, or rebuild.

•
Independently execute R&D fabrication work with limited oversight, including evaluating the job, planning the work, identifying material needs, and completing the build.

•
Adapt quickly when designs, p

title: Middle/Senior Product Analyst
description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

 

Маємо чудову можливість для тебе долучитися до одного з наших стрімко зростаючих бізнесів, який працює над social продуктами у сфері відеострімінгу.

Застосунки, які використовують наші рішення вже входять у топ свого сегменту, активно поширюються по всьому світу і мають понад 10 мільйонів завантажень. Ми впроваджуємо передові технології peer-to-peer аудіо та відеозв’язку, які використовуються в таких продуктах, як Telegram, WhatsApp та Google Meet.

Наші продукти активно зростають, а разом з ними зростає і наша команда. Саме тому ми шукаємо Product Analyst, який/яка допоможе знаходити точки росту і прискорити досягнення сміливих бізнес-цілей. Ми працюємо за транзакційною моделлю монетизації, а наші продукти включають велику кількість social interactions, що створює безліч викликів і запитань до аналітики.

Що будеш робити:

- Будеш генерувати продуктові ідеї і впливатимеш на бізнес. У тебе доступ до всіх продуктових зон і повна свобода копати там, де відчуваєш потенціал. Мінімум погоджень - результат своєї ідеї побачиш на метриках уже за кілька тижнів.

- Валідація продуктових гіпотез: продуктова команда генерує багато ідей, і твоя роль полягає в тому, щоб оцінити їх потенціал і правильно пріоритезувати.

- А/В-тестування: будеш супроводжувати тести повним циклом - від постановки гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і практичних рекомендацій бізнесу.

- Будеш налаштовувати event-based аналітику для нового функціоналу та покращувати її на вже існуючому, щоб коректно оцінювати вплив на поведінку користувачів.

Про тебе:

- 2+ роки досвіду в продуктовій аналітиці.

- Досвід роботи з А/В-тестами: від гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і рішення.

- Просунуті навички SQL та впевнена робота з інструментами візуалізації даних.

- Впроваджував автоматизацію в аналітичних процесах за допомогою AI-інструментів.

- У тебе високий рівень автономності: сам доводиш задачу до результату - від першого запитання до висновку, яким можна користуватись.

- Ти проактивний: не чекаєш, поки тобі поставлять задачу, а й сам знаходиш точки росту й ініціюєш дослідження.

- В тебе сильні комунікативні навички й вміння пояснювати складні дані мовою бізнесу

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід роботи з Amplitude та аналітикою мобільних застосунків.

- Досвід роботи з транзакційною моделлю монетизації

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager in San Francisco to build and run the programs that turn Modal's target accounts into active customers. You'll work closely with our Sales team to plan regional campaigns, run events for the engineers and technical leaders we sell to, and report on how those programs contribute to pipeline and revenue. This is a hands-on role for someone who has run account-based field programs at a technical company and wants to help shape the function as it grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Act as a strategic partner to Sales, aligning field programs with sales priorities and helping AEs create and accelerate pipeline in their territories.

- Develop and execute account-based programs for named accounts, working with Sales to identify key stakeholders and the right mix of touchpoints for each.

- Decide which industry conferences and sponsorships are worth investing in. Own what we bring, who we send, and whether we go back next year.

- Plan and host high-touch 1:1 and 1:few events for prospects and customers, such as executive dinners, roundtables, and technical workshops, in partnership with AEs.

- Own pre-event and post-event execution, including targeted invitations, meeting booking, and timely follow-up with Sales.

- Build co-marketing programs with VCs, accelerators, and ecosystem partners to reach their portfolio companies and customers.

- Track and report on program performance, including meetings booked, account engagement, and sourced and influenced pipeline, and use the results to plan future investment.

- Own the VIP experience at Modal's flagship events, including our annual conference, Runtime.

- Build repeatable processes and playbooks as the team grows.

REQUIREMENTS:

- A track record running field programs at a technical company. You can point to specific ones and clear outcomes.

- You've worked directly with AEs and you're happy sharing a number with them.

- Good judgment about where to spend. A lot of sponsorships look better than they perform, and you can tell which is which. Experience in AI or developer tools helps here.

The Washington Post is seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to design and operationalize the infrastructure that powers our go-to-market organization. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, systems, analytics, and execution - enabling revenue teams to operate with greater clarity, efficiency, and accountability.
This is a dual-ownership role: approximately half your time will be spent architecting frameworks, strategies, and operational models; the other half implementing, running, and iterating on them directly. title: AI Engineer (Computer Vision and Applied GenAI)
description:
Location: Amman, Jordan. Fully remote.
Type: Full-time, permanent.
Level: Mid-level, roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience.
Languages: English required. German is a strong plus.
About the role
We are looking for an AI Engineer based in Amman who will work remotely with a distributed engineering team. This is a builder role, not a research role. You will take AI capabilities from prototype to something that runs reliably in production, and you will own your work end to end: the model, the data around it, the service that serves it, and the evidence that it actually works.
The work spans two areas. On one side, computer vision and perception: camera pipelines, object detection and recognition, and inference that has to run fast and stay stable. On the other, applied generative AI: LLM-based features, retrieval, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest. You will not be handed a narrow slice of either. You will be expected to move between them and to build the plumbing that connects them to a real product.
Tasks

• Design, train, fine-tune and evaluate models for vision tasks (detection, classification, segmentation, tracking) and integrate them into production pipelines.

• Build LLM-powered features: retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents, structured extraction, and the prompt and evaluation infrastructure behind them.

• Write the services around the models: APIs, data pipelines, batch and streaming jobs, storage.

• Optimise for the target hardware, including quantisation, batching, and inference on edge devices where cloud inference is not an option.

• Define and track quality metrics. Establish a baseline before claiming an improvement, and be able to show where a number came from.

• Instrument, monitor and debug models in production: drift, latency, failure modes, and the unglamorous work of finding out why a pipeline broke at 3am.

• Work directly with product and business stakeholders to turn a vague need into a scoped, measurable deliverable.

• Document what you build so that the next engineer does not have to reverse-engineer it.

Requirements

• 3 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning or AI systems in production. Personal projects and Kaggle notebooks alone will not cover this.

• Strong Python. Clean, tested, reviewable code, not notebook-only output.

• Practical depth in at least one of the two areas below, and working familiarity with the other:

•
Computer vision: PyTorch or TensorFlow, OpenCV, modern detection and segmentation architectures, dataset creation and annotation workflows.

•
Applied GenAI: LLM APIs and open-weight models, RAG, embeddings and vector stores, agent frameworks, prompt design, and systematic evaluation.

• Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, testing, CI, Docker, and comfort on the Linux command line.

• Experience deploying a model as a service and keeping it running, including cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and basic observability.

• SQL and general data handling: you can find, clean and reason about the data before modelling it.

• Fluent written and spoken English, and the self-direction that remote work requires. You are comfortable writing things down, flagging blockers early, and working without someone checking in on you hourly.

Strong plus

•
German language skills. Part of the team and a meaningful share of the documentation, meetings and stakeholder communication are in German. Any level from solid B1 upward is a real advantage, and it will widen the scope of what you can own. It is not a hard requirement, and we will support you in improving it.

• Edge and embedded inference: NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO.

• Video streaming and industrial camera work: RTSP, GStreamer, GenICam, machine vision cameras.

• MLOps tooling: MLflow, Weights and Biases, DVC, Kubernetes, model registries.

• Experience in an industrial, robotics, IoT or B2B product environment.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer

At Shift, we’re business specialists dedicated to helping Australian SMEs take control of their cashflow, streamline trade terms and choose the right financial products.

We believe Australian businesses are the driving force behind our economy and are core to our communities. That’s why our business expertise, focus on relationships, and market-leading technology is at the core of everything we do. Our unique approach to product innovation combined with our collaborative culture means you can build your career in a supportive environment. You’ll be joining a diverse team of over 300 people who are always looking to deliver better outcomes for Australian businesses.

About the role:

At Shift, DevOps isn't a ticket queue. You won't be handed a change request and told to execute it, you'll be one of the people deciding how our cloud infrastructure gets built, secured and kept running. Our engineers carry real decision-making power, not just delivery responsibility, and the problems you'll be solving are ours alone to solve, because our data and decisioning capability is what makes Shift Shift. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own complex infrastructure and security work end to end.

- Lead complex DevOps and security initiatives across Shift's cloud environments, from design through to delivery.

- Build, maintain and continuously improve our automated deployment pipelines using DevOps best practice.

- Drive security testing, vulnerability scanning and remediation across production, data and operational infrastructure.

- Set the standard for security best practice - policies, risk assessments, controls and processes and guide the wider infrastructure team in applying it.

- Keep a live watch on emerging security threats and industry trends, and get ahead of risk before it becomes an incident.

- Partner closely with our engineering teams to embed security into applications and tooling from the start.

- Identify infrastructure and security uplift work that's been queued for too long, and lead it end to end - we'd rather fix things properly once than patch them repeatedly.

What you'll bring:

- 5+ years in a cloud infrastructure or security-focused technology role.

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (IaaS and PaaS) - we run on Azure, but strong AWS experience that translates across is welcome.

- Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Bash or C#).

- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, with working knowledge of Helm.

- A solid grasp of security fundamentals (IAM, WAF, vulnerability management) backed by real implementation experience.

- Experience with CSPM/KSPM tooling, network security controls (NSGs, application gateways, firewalls, private links), and secrets management (Azure Key Vault).

- Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Enterprise, GitOps via Flux CD or Argo CD, Octopus Deploy).

- Azure Entra ID experience is preferred; exposure to Azure SQL or APM tooling like Dynatrace is a bonus.

- Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for figuring things out rather than waiting for a playbook - the tempo here is fast and the team is lean.

Key benefits:

- Collaborative teams - a flat structure means everyone can learn from colleagues and senior leaders around the business.

- Be involved - come together with all of your colleagues every 100 days to share the product and technology roadmap and business strategy.

- Flexible working environment - we’re headquartered in North Sydney with state-based workplaces and offer a flexible work policy.

- Family support - industry leading 26 weeks paid parental leave.

- Purpose built spaces within our office - designed for collaboration, brainstorming, socialising, and focused work.

title: QA & Test Automation Developer (Canada, EST, Remote)
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a QA & Test Automation Developer to help us evolve how software quality is built, automated, and scaled across MindBridge.
Strong testing fundamentals are essential to this role. We are looking for someone who understands common testing heuristics, can identify meaningful product risks, and knows how to test and verify software beyond the obvious happy paths. You will use agentic tools to apply those skills faster and at greater scale without compromising testing depth or judgment.
You will design and maintain automated test suite, improve our quality engineering frameworks and delivery pipelines, and expand the use of AI agents within our QA processes. This includes creating, configuring and using agentic tools to accelerate test creation, analysis, failure triage, coverage assessment, and other recurring quality workflows.
As our product and software development practices become increasingly AI-native, you will also contribute to how we validate AI-powered features. Having direct experience testing AI agents, LLM-based features, or other non-deterministic systems is a strong asset.
What You Will Do
Quality engineering & automated testing
Apply strong testing fundamentals and heuristics to identify product risks, edge cases, failure modes, and gaps in expected behaviour Investigate failures and unexpected behaviour and act of them. Configure and use agentic tools with various degree of autonomy, to accelerate test creation, maintenance, analysis, failure triage, and other recurring QA activities. Advocate for testability and quality throughout the development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of our test frameworks, internal tooling, and automated quality gates. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically and ensure appropriate validation and human oversight remain part of the testing process.
Testing AI-powered systems
Contribute to test strategies for AI-powered, LLM-based, and agentic product capabilities. Help define how non-deterministic behaviour should be evaluated, including expected behaviour, quality thresholds, regression approaches, and failure analysis. Validate areas such as model responses, tool usage, grounding, consistency, error handling, latency, and end-to-end agent behaviour where applicable.
Collaboration & continuous improvement
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and other technical teams to make quality an integral part of software development. Share testing patterns, tools, and lessons learned, and continuously look for ways to improve testing effectiveness and delivery speed.
Required Qualifications
Strong software testing fundamentals, such as critical thinking, exploratory testing, test design, risk-based testing, common testing heuristics, and the ability to reason about customer and product impact. Hands-on experience designing and developing automated tests for modern software applications. Strong programming skills in at least one language commonly used for test automation or engineering, such as TypeScript/JavaScript or Python. Experience with modern test automation frameworks Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and incorporating automated testing into software delivery workflows. Ability to troubleshoot complex software and automated test failures across application, test, data, and infrastructure layers. Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development capabilities to automate or improve engineering and QA workflows. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across QA, Engineering, Product, and other technical teams. A continuous-improvement mindset and an interest in finding better ways to make software quality faster, more scalable, and more reliable.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM-based features, copilots, or autonomous or agentic systems. Experience developing evaluation frameworks or automated evaluations for non-deterministic AI

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

Yellow Card Zimbabwe will operate as a virtual asset service provider (VASP) within the regulatory perimeter overseen by the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) at the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe and other relevant authorities. The entity is expected to process high transaction volumes and requires a locally based AML Compliance Officer to meet Zimbabwean regulatory requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for an AML Compliance Officer to serve as the local AML compliance lead and money laundering reporting officer for Yellow Card Zimbabwe. Reporting directly to the Group AMLCO & MLRO, who is based in Johannesburg, you will be the in-country subject matter expert on Zimbabwean AML law and supervisory expectations, build strong relationships with the FIU, other regulators, and banking and payment partners, and provide day-to-day compliance support in a high-volume operational environment. • Provide guidance and support to the Group MLRO on Zimbabwean AML obligations, FATF and ESAAMLG expectations, and the practical application of local requirements to a VASP business model.

• Translate local regulatory developments into clear, actionable advice for product, operations, customer-facing, and leadership teams.

Regulator and Partner Engagement

• Act as the entity's resident compliance contact for registration, renewal, reporting, inspections, and information requests, ensuring responses are timely, accurate, and well evidenced.

• Represent the Zimbabwean entity in routine regulator and partner interactions, in close coordination with the Group MLRO and external counsel where required.

AML Program Implementation

• Ensure program controls reflect Zimbabwean requirements on customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, record keeping, ongoing monitoring, and internal reporting.

High-Volume Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

title: Senior/Staff Data Scientist
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Dependability Teams

Our Product Dependability team connects Wayve’s embodied AI technology with the demands of real-world automotive products. Working across systems engineering, safety, cybersecurity and data analysis, the team helps translate AI capabilities into dependable vehicle-level behavior and supports integration with our OEM partners.

As a Senior Data Scientist within this team, you’ll use data to understand how our driving models perform, where their limitations lie, and whether our evaluation methods reflect real-world customer needs. You’ll help define data collection and validation requirements, identify gaps or bias in datasets, and turn your findings into actionable recommendations for model development and product improvement.

You’ll collaborate closely with model developers, engineering, validation and product teams. This isn’t a model-building role-it’s an opportunity to influence what we develop, how we evaluate it, and the evidence we use to demonstrate dependable performance.⁠

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Analyze target markets to understand road infrastructure, weather, traffic density, local driving behaviors and regulatory requirements.

- Define ODD boundaries, edge conditions and potential failure triggers to inform data collection and system design.

- Map the driving competencies required in each region, quantifying their complexity and frequency using traffic data and real-world observations.

- Analyze model performance metrics and behavioral patterns to identify data gaps, edge-case risks and opportunities for improvement.

- Use historical data and statistical models to understand behaviors affecting reliability and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF).

- Translate your findings into actionable data strategies, technical requirements and deployment recommendations with cross-functional partners.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- ODD characterization: Build a detailed understanding of the environments our systems need to operate in, including geography, infrastructure, road types, weather and local traffic conditions.

We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to protect our customers from bot attacks. title: Design Engineer
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an outstanding engineer with a real passion for design.

Nubank's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer - which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nubank scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

NuBrain - the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture - how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

A design quality measurement platform. The function knows what good looks like and has the parameters written down; scoring a flow against them is currently a manual exercise in Figma. The goal is an index - a real number for the quality of a given experience - produced by a system, not a spreadsheet.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform - that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Architect and build the systems design at Nubank runs on - increasingly agentic ones.

- Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.

- Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.

- Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

- Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.

- Be the technical voice in a design organization - make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

An outstanding, deeply experienced engineer. This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on.

A track record architecting UX systems. Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale - design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

A love for design that shows up in your work. Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

Agentic systems that help design scale. Ideally you've built them - agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do mo

title: Senior Software Engineer, SLAM/VIO
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We are building the perception stack that enables robust three/six degrees of freedom tracking, localization, and mapping in complex real-world environments. This role focuses on fusing data from cameras and inertial sensors to power SLAM / Visual-Inertial Odometry pipelines. We need an experienced perception software engineer who can create algorithms and systems that run in real time, handle uncertainty gracefully, and provide the foundation for advanced spatial intelligence on edge devices.

 

Responsibilities

- Develop and optimize sensor fusion algorithms combining IMU and camera data for SLAM and VIO (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping & Visual Inertial Odometry)

- Implement state of the art structure-from-motion techniques using different sensor modalities to generate consistent 3D reconstructions

- Evaluate algos against public benchmarks and real-world datasets

- Integrate outputs into higher-level autonomy or collaborative mapping systems (i.e. shared mapping systems)

- Collaborate with HW, robotics and platform teams to ensure end-to-end performance

- Define metrics, testing frameworks and deployment strategies for production-ready perception systems

Requirements

- BS with 10+ years of academic or industry experience in inertial sensing, computer vision, robotics or related fields with shipped or published work (or MS with 8+ yrs of the above)

- Shipped SLAM/VIO features to product

- Strong background in linear algebra, 3D geometry, VIO (probabilistic filtering and/or factor-graph optimization), and visual mapping (incremental mapping, submaps, loop closure)

- Proficient in C++/Python with experience in real-time optimization

- Proficient in using and debugging geometric optimization frameworks (e.g. Ceres, GTSAM, g2o)

- Knowledge of sensor modelling, calibration and noise characteristics

- Experience with real-time processing pipelines on embedded or edge hardware

- Preferred track record of applied research in robotics or AR/VR
